title: On Nilpotent and Hypocentral Quandle Homomorphisms
summary: We introduce a notion of nilpotency for surjective quandle homomorphisms, which relativizes the nilpotency of quandles recently defined by Darné. A surjective homomorphism is called nilpotent if its relative inner automorphism group is nilpotent relative to the inner automorphism group of the source. We show that this condition can equally be described through the relative transvection group and the relative adjoint group, and that it is equivalent to being a finite composite of covering homomorphisms.
